title: empirical_feature
description: Family A — the WSB-side (community) cell. What the crowd is doing. Community-sourced only (no market data). See data-dictionary.md §3 and signals-catalog.md §3.1.
x-grain: ticker × window_start × resolution (× platform when per-source)

ticker.description: Whitelist-validated symbol; must exist in instrument.

window_start.description: Inclusive lower bound of the half-open window [window_start, +len(resolution)).

resolution.description: Window length. 1h is the v0.0.1 primary (implicit today; explicit here).

platform.description: Optional grain extension: null/absent = combined community view; a Platform value = a per-source cell. When present it extends the natural key (enables cross-platform signals).

mentions.description: Distinct (thing × ticker) references this window. A raw count — never the ranker.

authors.description: Distinct accounts (bots filtered). Drives the H_e support shrink.

sov.description: Share of voice — THE primary ranker. mentions(T) / Σ mentions(all T) this window.

velocity.x-null: no prior window exists (cold start or polling gap)
velocity.description: 1st derivative: mentions(W) − mentions(W−1) same resolution. null (not 0) when no prior.

accel.x-null: velocity or its prior is undefined
accel.description: 2nd derivative: velocity(W) − velocity(W−1). Early-breakout signal; negatives floored to 0 in H_e.

rank.description: Position on the sov leaderboard (1 = top). Computed today; persist in the canonical model.

rank_delta.description: SoV places climbed vs the previous window: prior_rank − cur_rank. +ve = climbing; 0 when no prior rank.

z.x-degrades-when: baseline cold/warming (forward-only warmup); Reddit backfill improves it
z.description: (mentions − μ_base)/σ_base vs same hour-of-week history. Weight 0 in H_e until ready.

net_dir.description: (bull − bear)/(bull + bear) over direction tokens. Direction, not ironic sentiment. H_e uses |net_dir|.

dd_count.x-null: Reddit source absent (Discord-only cell); 0 = observed-zero DD posts. A null conviction term is EXCLUDED from H_e and weights renormalize, not zero-substituted.
dd_count.description: # DD-flaired posts (Reddit-unique). null = no Reddit data this cell.

yolo_usd.description: Σ disclosed position $ this window (text now; OCR/vision later). Per-item evidence, never a win rate.

flair_counts.x-null: Reddit source absent (Discord-only cell); empty {} = Reddit present, no flairs
flair_counts.description: Mentions split by Reddit flair, e.g. {"DD":2,"YOLO":7}. Discord analog = channel breakdown.

astroturf.description: Share of mentions from new accounts / coordinated bursts. A warning, not a trade.

baseline_status.description: Whether z is trustworthy: cold → warming → ready.

h_e.description: WSB Heat — composite 'how hot on WSB now' + the ranker. Weighted max-normed blend × support shrink. Community-only; needs no market data. See data-dictionary §10.2.

total_window_mentions.description: Σ mentions across all tickers in this (window_start, resolution) — the sov denominator and the basis of quiet.

quiet.description: total_window_mentions < min_window_mentions ⇒ low-confidence window. A window-trust flag on the cell, not just the snapshot.

computed_at.description: When this cell was derived (observation time).
